title: On the Alignment of Large Language Models with Global Human Opinion
findings: When using religion as a baseline for opinion alignment, most religious groups were found to be under-aligned with the average human religious opinion, with the notable exception of Judaism, which was appropriately aligned. In tests of internal consistency on the topic of atheism, most LLMs maintained full consistency, but GPT-3.5-Turbo showed only 50% consistency.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures the alignment of Large Language Models' opinions with the average opinions of various human demographic groups, including religious groups, based on questions from the World Values Survey (WVS). For religion specifically, it assessed alignment on survey questions about belief in God, hell, and life after death, and also checked for internal consistency in responses related to atheism.
